name: nf-foreign-income
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island foreign-income inclusion and foreign income tax offsets for 2026-27. Use for overseas interest, dividends, employment, rent, foreign gains, tax paid later, currency conversion and double-tax relief. Covers temporary-resident and foreign-service gates, eligible foreign tax, income matching, the ordinary offset limit and A$1,000 floor, non-refundable use, amendments and records. Includes current primary legislation, authority guidance and fictional components. Requires separate residence, income character, treaty, payment and translation evidence. Preserves applicable workflow outputs and holds specialised entity, minimum-tax and actual-return computations. This source-cited reference does not complete the cross-border or country pack.
